note: Generated by generate_vectors.py. Matrices from python-qrcode, EIGHT per case (one per forced data mask), each decoded by zxing-cpp before being committed. oracle_mask records which one python-qrcode would have chosen; it is informational, because implementations legitimately differ there (see the script docstring). segno_agrees is a third opinion; false means segno's known padding deviation, not a fault in the fixture. Do not hand-edit: a fixture edited to match our encoder is not evidence of anything.
